messages:
Iris Park: Heads up — Solaris Edge (acct SE-618) missed INV-2026-210 for $31,200. They emailed asking to split and to reverse $2,100 for an apparent ingestion duplication. Tagging CS + Billing.
Diego Morales: Pulling records now. No active payment plan. Invoice is 35 days overdue. No previous credits. Ticket created TKT-5356.
Priya - CS: Customer called. They said a partner timeout retried a batch and they see duplicated rows in their dashboard. They want a 3-month schedule and the $2,100 credit. Said they'll pay initial if we accept.
Nadia Chen: Collections policy: we can approve up to 90 days if initial >= 30%. Credits <= $2,000 are on my authority; anything above needs legal. So $2,100 needs sign-off. We should also confirm eng findings first.
Diego Morales: Proposed compromise: Offer a 35/32.5/32.5 split with a $2,000 goodwill credit (cap manager-approved). Require signed agreement and initial 35% cleared before lifting any suspension.
Priya - CS: Solaris asked if we can hold suspension for 14 days while they arrange wires. They also requested that invoice line items redact internal job IDs.
Iris Park: I can ok a one-time 35/32.5/32.5 schedule if Legal signs off on $2,100 or we cap at $2,000. Sam, can you do quick review for $2,100? We need clause: "credit contingent on executed payment agreement and acknowledgement of remediation timeline."
Sam (Legal): Quick take — we can approve $2,100 provided the DocuSign includes the contingency clause and a statement that this is a one-time goodwill credit. Also require customer acknowledgement that they will provide a contact for remediation verification. No other redlines.
collections-bot: Dunning notice #3 sent at 1981235600. Auto-suspend timer paused for 48h while negotiating.
Nadia Chen: OK — approve $2,100 credit with Sam's requested language. Conditions: initial 35% ($10,920) due by 2025-12-06, 32.5% ($10,140) due 2026-01-06, 32.5% ($10,140) due 2026-02-06. Waive this cycle's late fee if initial payment clears. Add account note: "Conditional payment plan; credit contingent on signed agreement and remediation confirmation."
Diego Morales: Drafting INV-2026-210-A with $2,100 credit and the payment schedule. Will send via DocuSign. Billing will sanitize invoice lines to remove job IDs.
Priya - CS: Customer verbally accepted those terms and asked for DocuSign. They also asked for an emailed copy of the credit memo for their AP team.
Diego Morales: DocuSign sent at 1981236800. Collections-bot: DocuSign viewed at 1981236900. Reminder scheduled: initial-payment-reminder on 2025-12-05.
Priya - CS: I've told them we will withhold suspension until 2026-01-05 provided initial payment posts and DocuSign is executed within 72h. If either condition fails, we resume suspension immediately.
Iris Park: Add escalation: if initial payment not posted by 2025-12-07, escalate to VP Finance. Diego, please post receipts when funds land and update ledger.
collections-bot: Set reminder: verify-initial-payment on 2025-12-07.
Sam (Legal): Reviewed DocuSign text at 1981237400. Minor tweak: add "one-time goodwill" phrase and the remediation acknowledgement. Approved after tweak.
Diego Morales: Updated DocuSign and resent at 1981237520. DocuSign viewed at 1981237620.
Priya - CS: Customer asked us to replace the invoice description with a high-level phrase ("data processing overage") instead of job IDs. Diego confirmed billing sanitized it.
Nadia Chen: Noted. If engineering later confirms it wasn't our fault, we'll document that and reverse the credit decision for future reference, but maintain the agreed credit now.
Iris Park: Summary: Approve $2,100 credit (one-time), 35/32.5/32.5 payment plan, hold suspension until 2026-01-05 contingent on initial 35% cleared and signed agreement in 72h. Escalate to VP Finance if initial payment not received by 2025-12-07.
Diego Morales: I'll monitor payments and post updates. Thanks team.
